attempts.summary: Configured daily log rotation for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 via /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app: daily, rotate 7, compress + delaycompress (7 compressed rotations retained), copytruncate so the app keeps writing to the same inode without needing a restart/signal. Verified with a dry-run and two forced live rotations that files rotate, compress on the following cycle, and that writes appended immediately after rotation land correctly. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the logrotate config, app.log data, and logrotate.timer all survived and remained healthy post-restart.
